title: S&P DJI March 2027 quarterly rebalance — constituent changes announced and pro-forma files released after the close
source: EST: forward derivation from the owner's own release archive, RECONSTRUCTED AND RE-PARSED BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal. Nine index pages of S&P Dow Jones Indices' newsroom fetched direct by plain curl (press.spglobal.com/index.php?s=2429&l=100 plus offsets o=100..800, HTTP 200 each, ~117KB each), yielding 899 unique dated releases spanning 2022-05-06 to 2026-09-04. Of the 18 quarterly rebalance cycles in that window, 17 produced a constituent announcement and ALL 17 landed on the FIRST FRIDAY two weeks before that month's third Friday, checked by weekday arithmetic computed in-session: 2022-06-03, 2022-09-02, 2022-12-02, 2023-03-03, 2023-06-02, 2023-09-01, 2023-12-01, 2024-03-01, 2024-06-07, 2024-09-06, 2024-12-06, 2025-03-07, 2025-09-05, 2025-12-05, 2026-03-06, 2026-06-05, 2026-09-04. MARCH IS 4 FOR 4 (2023-03-03, 2024-03-01, 2025-03-07, 2026-03-06) and each of the 17 releases was then fetched individually (HTTP 200, 55KB-99KB each) and parsed to 700 constituent rows — the same count the sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04 sibling reported, reached here by an independent fetch and parser. The first Friday of March 2027 is 2027-03-05 (March 2027's Fridays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th; the third Friday 2027-03-19 is already tracked as opex-2027-03-19). Filed estimate on three counts, none of them date doubt: the March 2027 document does not exist yet, the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule, and this lane may not self-confirm. The methodology primary remains blocked — spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/methodologies/methodology-sp-us-indices.pdf returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-09 (recorded in this event's ledger probe-ref.blocked); nothing was silently substituted for it. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), which read the single proposal carrying this id (proposals/sp-rebalance-proforma-2027-03-05.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22.json) in full first and then re-established the date from the owner's release archive rather than inheriting a seven-instance induction. Ledger: docs/research/events/sp-rebalance-proforma-2027-03-05.md. THE FINDING THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO CARRY, AND IT SETTLES A QUESTION THREE SIBLINGS LEFT OPEN: the announcement effect is real, large and near-perfectly reliable — and it lands ENTIRELY in a print no reader of the release can transact. On 318 clean (non-migration) name-cycles across all 17 releases, signed by the direction each name's index action predicts and measured as excess over its own tier's ETF, the reaction session runs +4.21% mean / +3.86% median at 278 of 318 correctly signed (p<0.001%). Decomposed, +3.65% mean / +3.44% median of that is the OPENING GAP (291 of 318, p<0.001%, 89% of the median total) and only +0.58% mean / +0.33% median is the open-to-close remainder, at 176 of 318 (p=6.4%, not significant). At the honest unit of independence — the CYCLE, since names inside one release share one tape — the gap is positive in 16 of 17 cycles (p=0.03%) and the intraday remainder in 8 of 17 (p=100%, median-of-medians -0.03%), a perfect null. The only trade this house could place, long-only because shorting is blocked house-wide — buy the announced additions equal-weighted at the reaction-session open, sell at that close — wins 8 of 17 cycles, mean +0.29%, median -0.14%, t=0.53, worst -4.30%, against the same cohort's +4.95% mean per-cycle gap that was positive in 17 of 17 and is unavailable to it. Holding to the effective-session close instead is 8 of 16, mean +0.05%, t=0.05, on triple the variance. THIS AMENDS THE DECEMBER SIBLING'S STANCE WITH NUMBERS: sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04 framed its refusal as a capability statement that 'expires the moment the capability does' and made a small-cap execution instrument its kill switch. It would not help — the effect is not in the session an instrument could trade. THE ONE DURABLE OUTPUT IS TURNOVER, NOT RETURN: named constituents print 4.08x mean / 3.41x median their own trailing-60 median volume on the reaction session, 246 of 310 above 2x, with cycle medians running 1.91x to 6.17x and 16 of 16 measurable cycles above 1.5x. That is an E1-class execution hazard on the reaction session and never a direction. ONE MECHANICAL CORRECTION TO THE FAMILY'S OWN RULE STATEMENT: the effective date is the first TRADING day after the third Friday, not 'the Monday' — the 2022-06-03 release's own effective-date column reads June 21, 2022, a Tuesday, because Monday 2022-06-20 was the first NYSE-observed Juneteenth closure. 2027 is unaffected (Monday 2027-03-22 is an ordinary session), but the rule is stated as 'Monday' in four sibling entries. ONE RISK WITH A MEASURED BASE RATE: the release DATE is 17 for 17 but the release EXISTING is 17 of 18 — June 2025 produced no quarterly constituent announcement at all (nothing on 2025-06-06, and nothing in the 2025-05-15..2025-07-15 archive window beyond off-cycle singles), so roughly 1 cycle in 18 publishes no cohort. Registered as FT-sp-rebalance-proforma-2027-03-05-3. NO DATED ADJACENT PROPOSED and the reasons are on the record: the corridor within five days is already tracked (nerc-computational-load-phase-ii-workplan-2027-03-01, fomc-blackout-start-2027-03-06); the reaction session 2027-03-08 is this event's consequence rather than a separate publication; the share/IWF freeze is a data cut-off with no observable publication, declined by two siblings for that reason; and a capped/alt-weighted pro-forma for 2027-03-12 was already deliberately declined by the proposing sweep because that date carries sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12. Symbols deliberately EMPTY: the March 2027 roster does not exist until this release publishes. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure entries; EventKind has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane. Filed estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
